summary_en: TX1 Corporation submitted a corrected public tender offer filing on October 6, 2026, following receipt of notifications from the Fair Trade Commission on October 1–2, 2026, confirming no exclusionary order and approving acceleration of the review period for its acquisition of ProjectHoldings, Inc. shares.
title_en: Notice of Change: Regarding Change of Notice of Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Shares of ProjectHoldings, Inc. (Securities Code: 9246) by TX1 Corporation, Accompanying Submission of Amended Public Tender Offer Filing
translation_en_brief:
TX1 Corporation filed an amended public tender offer document with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau on October 6, 2026, following receipt of formal notifications from the Fair Trade Commission (FTC) dated October 1, 2026. The FTC provided two notifications: (1) confirmation that no exclusionary order would be issued, and (2) approval to shorten the mandatory review period. These notifications were received by TX1 on October 2, 2026.

The amendment was necessary because the earlier filing submitted on September 29, 2026, contained language regarding the FTC review period that required correction in light of the FTC's decision. The original filing had stated that the measurement and acquisition prohibition periods were scheduled to expire on October 9, 2026, as a matter of course. With the FTC's notice of no exclusionary order and approval of accelerated review, the conditions affecting the timing and conduct of the tender offer have been clarified.

The disclosure indicates that completion of the FTC process—absent any exclusionary order, any report demand, or any emergency injunction application by a court—removes one of the contingencies that could have led to termination of the tender offer. TX1 is obligated under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act to notify the FTC immediately if the review period expires without further notice from the FTC authority.
